// Annotation definitions in the DDLA form the system returns (ADT annotationDefinitions()),
// for the keys the value-help tests reason about: every Consumption.valueHelp* key and the
// ObjectModel / Search keys the tiering depends on. Scope and API state as S/4HANA 2023
// declares them. Annotation metadata, not program source.

annotation Consumption {
  @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
  @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS]
  valueHelp : ElementRef;
  valueHelpDefault : {
    binding : {
      @Scope:[#ELEMENT]
      @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
      usage : String(30) enum { FILTER; FILTER_AND_RESULT; RESULT; };
    };
    @Scope:[#ELEMENT]
    @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
    display : Boolean default true;
    @Scope:[#ENTITY]
    @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
    fetchValues : String(30) enum { AUTOMATICALLY_WHEN_DISPLAYED; ON_EXPLICIT_REQUEST; };
    @Scope:[#ELEMENT]
    @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
    initialValueIsSignificant : Boolean default true;
  };
  valueHelpDefinition : array of {
    additionalBinding : array of {
      @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
      @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
      element : String(40);
      @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
      @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
      localConstant : String(255);
      @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
      @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
      localElement : ElementRef;
      @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
      @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
      localParameter : ParameterRef;
      @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
      @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
      parameter : String(40);
      @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
      @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
      usage : String(30) enum { FILTER; FILTER_AND_RESULT; RESULT; };
    };
    @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
    @API.state: []
    association : AssociationRef;
    @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
    @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
    distinctValues : Boolean default true;
    @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
    @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
    enabled : ElementRef;
    entity : {
      @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
      @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
      element : String(40);
      @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #ENTITY, #PARAMETER]
      @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
      name : EntityRef;
    };
    @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
    @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
    label : String(60);
    @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
    @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
    presentationVariantQualifier : String(120);
    @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
    @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
    qualifier : String(120);
    @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
    @API.state: []
    selectionVariantQualifier : String(120);
    @Scope:[#ELEMENT, #PARAMETER]
    @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
    useForValidation : Boolean default true;
  };
};

annotation ObjectModel {
  @Scope:[#ENTITY, #TABLE_FUNCTION]
  @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
  dataCategory : String(30) enum { HIERARCHY; TEXT; VALUE_HELP; };
  @Scope:[#ENTITY]
  @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
  modelingPattern : String(60) enum { ANALYTICAL_CUBE; ANALYTICAL_DIMENSION; ANALYTICAL_FACT; ANALYTICAL_KPI; ANALYTICAL_PARENT_CHILD_HIERARCHY_NODE; ANALYTICAL_QUERY; COLLECTIVE_VALUE_HELP; DATA_STRUCTURE; DERIVATION_FUNCTION; ENTERPRISE_SEARCH_PROVIDER; LANGUAGE_DEPENDENT_TEXT; NONE; OUTPUT_EMAIL_DATA_PROVIDER; OUTPUT_FORM_DATA_PROVIDER; OUTPUT_PARAMETER_DETERMINATION_DATA_SOURCE; PARENT_CHILD_HIERARCHY_NODE_PROVIDER; SITUATION_ANCHOR; SITUATION_DATACONTEXT; SITUATION_TRIGGER; TRANSACTIONAL_ENTITY; TRANSACTIONAL_INTERFACE; TRANSACTIONAL_PROJECTED_ENTITY; TRANSACTIONAL_QUERY; VALUE_HELP_PROVIDER; };
  @Scope:[#ENTITY, #TABLE_FUNCTION]
  @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
  representativeKey : KeyElementRef;
  @Scope:[#ENTITY]
  @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
  supportedCapabilities : array of String(60) enum { ANALYTICAL_DIMENSION; ANALYTICAL_KPI; ANALYTICAL_PARENT_CHILD_HIERARCHY_NODE; ANALYTICAL_PROVIDER; ANALYTICAL_QUERY; CDS_MODELING_ASSOCIATION_TARGET; CDS_MODELING_DATA_SOURCE; COLLECTIVE_VALUE_HELP; DATA_STRUCTURE; DERIVATION_FUNCTION; ENTERPRISE_SEARCH_PROVIDER; EXTRACTION_DATA_SOURCE; KEY_USER_COPYING_TEMPLATE; LANGUAGE_DEPENDENT_TEXT; OUTPUT_EMAIL_DATA_PROVIDER; OUTPUT_FORM_DATA_PROVIDER; OUTPUT_PARAMETER_DETERMINATION_DATA_SOURCE; PARENT_CHILD_HIERARCHY_NODE_PROVIDER; SEARCHABLE_ENTITY; SITUATION_ANCHOR; SITUATION_DATACONTEXT; SITUATION_TRIGGER; SQL_DATA_SOURCE; TRANSACTIONAL_PROVIDER; VALUE_HELP_PROVIDER; };
};

annotation Search {
  @Scope:[#ENTITY]
  @API.state: [#RELEASED_FOR_KEY_USER_APPS, #RELEASED_FOR_SAP_CLOUD_PLATFORM]
  searchable : Boolean default true;
};
